theorems.name: Submission.fiw_ims_sc_series_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ), (∀ r, ENNReal.ofReal |a r| ≤ m r * ENNReal.ofReal C) → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * m r) < ∞ → Summable (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * a r) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal |∑' r, (c r : ℝ) * a r| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * ∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * m r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
